calibration_required.height_and_outer_diameter: Measure actual empty 550mL SKU with calipers; 227x64mm are web user-reported.
calibration_required.pet_bottle_mass: Weigh PET bottle after removing cap and label on 0.01g scale.
calibration_required.cap_mass: Weigh cap; default 1.8g from generic 30/25 closure producer.
calibration_required.label_mass: Weigh detached dry label; default 0.7g estimated.
calibration_required.thread_pitch_and_neck: Visual screw thread is approximate and is not an industrial screw-fit CAD.
calibration_required.com_and_inertia: Based on PET shell thickness model, not measured.
calibration_required.deformation: Bodies are rigid; empty PET buckling requires a deformable model.
